hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '\.(env|env\.local|env\.production|env\.development)$' && { echo 'BLOCKED: .env files are protected. Edit manually in your editor.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|md|css)$' && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
